from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document to enable category mapping."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The document identifier/title (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    primary_legal_domain: str = Field(description="Broad legal domain: '行政', '民事', '刑事', or '执行'")
    explicit_case_cause: str | None = Field(description="Explicit cause of action or case type stated in the text, if any")
    core_dispute: str = Field(description="The specific legal issue or administrative act at the center of the case")
    category_mapping_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Specific phrases or terms that map to the provided category list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
